description: Use as a SELLER right after the buyer accepted your quote: returns the exact deal terms to sign (EIP-712). Nothing moves, but the escrow contract only opens the deal with this signature. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_consent_plan
